notes.title: The Attachment Rework Patch!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] We have reworked the values for all attachments to be more unique while leveling the weapons. Attachments will now mostly effect a single stat until the final attachment.
[*] We have removed rarity from attachments as it felt like it was forcing players to choose a rarity over the values they wanted.
[*] We have now added a stats number value to the right of each stats bar when customizing weapons. This is for those of you who want to see the exact number change when modifying weapons.
[*] A "Pierce" icon has been added to pistols, shotguns, and snipers. Pistols and shotguns will Pierce 1 zombie, while Snipers will piece 2 zombies.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fix - Black screen upon loading
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] We have fixed a game breaking bug that would cause a black screen upon loading of the game. This was caused when a player would run the game offline; the game would fail to move to offline mode and instead break. Please let us know if you continue to have any issues on loading.
[/list]

notes.title: Major Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Foreign Language keyboards, such as Japanese, Korean, or Chinese, should no longer break the game when pressing the "Chat" key. This has been an elusive bug that has existed since the game launch. Please let us know if this is not resolved for any of you.
[*] A few players have mentioned being unable to exit the language menu when first launching the game. We are not able to replicate this issue, however we have created a failsafe. When the game is first launched, the language menu will auto disappear after 30 seconds if no language is chosen.
[*] Thank you to the players who have reported menus being stuck on screen from the Gun Customize UI, after the wave has started. We have put extra code on the UI buttons to ensure no menu can be double-opened, which we believe was causing the additional UI to be stuck on top.
[/list]

Please let us know on the discussion forum if you continue to experience any of these, or new issues. We will always try to address them as soon as possible!

notes.title: The Partial Controller Support Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43643750/cf30bd87be4212bd41cd8a15b197cebb86e9ddcb.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Partial Controller Support has been added to ZBD2 and can be toggled on in the options menu,
[*] Due to the nature of how the game was originally designed for mouse and keyboard, most menus require the use of the right thumb stick to guide the mouse cursor. 
[*] Toggling controller support will temporarily replace the keyboard key bindings. Unchecking controller input will revert back to the previously bound keys.
[/list]

notes.title: Chat (Enter) Key Bind, Skippable Cutscenes & Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] We have added the ability to bind the Chat button to other key inputs. We were kindly informed that pressing enter on international keyboards can break the game, as it was. Please let us know if you still experience issues after rebinding the Chat key!
[*] The user interfaces should now properly display the bound key instead of the default key for buttons.
[*] Boss cutscenes are now skippable by the host if they press spacebar.
[*] End of Act totals menu is now skippable by the host if they press spacebar.
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause barbwire to be destroyed by special zombie abilities.
[*] Added an additional catch to the code for starting a wave so that players who get stuck in shop will be auto forced out of the shop.
[/list]

notes.title: Endless - Wave 22 Bug Fix!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] We have fixed a bug that was causing players to have 0 ammo when starting wave 22 in Endless mode.
[/list]

notes.title: Endless Difficulty Adjustment & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] We have reduced the Endless Wave 20 zombie health increase by half.
[*] We have fixed a bug that would cause the players who joined Endless mode via matchmaking to see the story mode UI at the top of their screen.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused highlighted attachments to display worse on the stats bar, despite having better values. This is just a bug fix, not the attachment overhaul patch which is coming at a later date.
[/list]

notes.title: The Endless Update!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Endless Mode has been added and is available to everyone. Clicking the Act button on the main menu will now give you the option to choose a story mode or endless mode.
[*] Cannon and Saw turrets built next to each other will now have enough room for players to move between them.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that would allow infinite grenades if a 5th player somehow joined a game. 
[*] Fixed what we believe is the cause of a 5th player joining public matches and will be testing today to confirm this is resolved.
[*] Fixed an issue on Act 6 that allowed players to escape the level through a crate's opening.
[*] Fixed an issue with matchmaking that caused players who joined during the Crane boss battle to spawn outside that map and be unable to participate in the fight.
[/list]

notes.title: Act 6 Minigame Bug Fix!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] We've rewritten the code for the Act 6 Foot Race minigame to resolve issues with players sometimes being unable to move in multiplayer races.
[*] Added additional assets and code for the upcoming Endless Mode.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Background Preperations!
notes.notes:
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the Escape Menu UI that would not properly display text and colors for Maxed out weapons and rank.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Escape Menu UI that would localized cause text to overrun UI borders.
[/list]

[h3]Background Preparation[/h3]
[list]
[*] We are making changes in the background in preparation for the new Endless Mode that will be in our next Content Update. We will post more information regarding the new mode as release draws closer. Please let us know if you notice any new bugs with zombies.
[/list]

notes.title: Japanese and Chinese Language update!

[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Rank 100 achievement to not be gifted. When logging into the game or reloading a match, the achievement will now properly unlock if you are Rank 100.
[*] Fixed a bug with the Disco Boss that would cause the speed up phase not to trigger if players didn't kill the second speaker on the first try.
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause the host player to receive more keys and experience than the clients.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Progress UI to not properly display the correct number of unlocked items, or the correct unlockable total items.

notes.title: More Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:

[*] Fixed a bug that would cause players to revive in the water during the Sewer Boss fight if they died near the edge of the water.
[*] We have put proper boundaries on the vehicle minigame to keep some players from being launched to space when being rammed by other players.
[*] Increased chat text size by 25% and increase chat possible length.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause upgrading barricades to trigger twice in multiplayer games, costing additional gold.
[*] Fixed an occasional bug that could be caused by building a structure where it isn't allowed to be placed, consuming the gold cost but not placing the structure.
[*] Fixed a bug that could the shop to be opened twice, causing the affected player to be unable to control their character.
[*] Fixed a bug that could sometimes allow matchmaking players to join friends only games.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Emissary's Grips and Scopes to incorrectly attach to the weapon.
[*] Increase Emissary's damage and rate of fire significantly.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Adjusted boundaries of all defense areas to fix the occasional issue of a player getting stuck on the environment. This same fix also keeps anyone from escaping. It's not safe out there.
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause players to incorrectly defeat the Disco boss if not all zombies were killed during the slow song.
[*] Increased the radius detected for player overlap to keep players from getting stuck in each other.
[/list]

notes.title: 1 Shot in Hell Difficulty Available! + Bug Fixes + Russian Translation Overhaul
notes.notes:
[h2]HELL Difficulty[/h2]
[list]
[*] One Shot In Hell difficulty has been enabled for all Acts! This is a boss ONLY difficulty, and every point of damage you take is fatal. We will be modifying some boss abilities going forward to be more challenging when playing this difficulty.
[/list]
[h2]Russian Translation[/h2]
[list]
[*] A big thank you to ZBD2 player Hooxie for helping us fix our poor Russian translation!
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing the progress UI screen to not correctly display the unlocked RANK cards.
[*]Fixed an issue that would cause chat not to open, until the background was clicked, if the Main Menu's Act button had been recently pressed. 
[*]Fixed an issue causing the End of Act UI Rank Progress Bar to malfunction towards the higher %.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Phantom to contain two Force Sight attachments.
[*] Rephrased wording of Alert message when trying to buy the next weapon in a class, without maxing out the previous.
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause players to occasionally become stuck inside one another, until one or both died.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Act 4 Defense area boundaries have been raised to keep players from escaping...again.
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause chat to display in front of the load screen.
[*] Fixed localization issue with the Shop's Gun Highlight UI so it now translates properly.
[*] Disco boss speakers models should now display properly.
[*] Added additional zombie spawns to the Act 3 Disco Boss green squares phase.
[*] Fixed a bug caused when a player died to zombies after finishing the timer, but prior to the last zombie being killed.
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause the shop keeper to not leave once he was dismissed.
[*] Significantly raised the amount of sounds the game allows to relieve the bug that causes player sounds to cut out during heavy gameplay
[*] The UI at the end of an act should now show proper movement of experience in the Rank Experience bar.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes of the Day #2
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Disco Boss's health bar to not reflect the current value when playing on Casual.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused zombies that died to shotgun blasts to constantly fall to the right, to the right. Everything you own in a box..nevermind.
[*] Characters at the main menu should now be properly lit. ːsteammockingː
[*] Fixed a bug that caused zombies to disappear instantly at the end of boss fights, instead of dying a proper death.
[/list]

notes.title: Text Chat is Back! Bug Fixes & Balancing
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Text Chat is now re-enabled, fixed, and overhauled. The chat should now function properly, and feel snappier.
[*] Friends only was the previous enabled by default when starting a match and this caused a lot of confusion as to why there were no public games available. We have changed the default friends only box to unchecked. To run games as friends only, please check the box on the main menu before starting the match, or from the escape menu when already inside a match.
[*] The End of Wave UI should now properly display the keys given for completing the 5th Wave.
[*] Fixed an issue with the End of Wave Totals UI, and End of Act Totals UI, displaying incorrect Ranks and XP Bar values. I was the issue. Math is hard.
[*] Replaced the Gunner Ability shout to sound like it comes from an actual human. Also fixed this sound so it no longer blows out your speakers.
[*] The Auto Turret ability will no longer play loud an uninhibited.
[*] Snipers now pierce 1 additional zombie per bullet. Effectively increasing sniper damage by up to 50% in some instances.
[*] Shotgun damage reduced by 10 to 15%.
[*] LMG's damage increased by 10%.
[*] LMG reload time decreased by 20%.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes & Achievements Retroactive Fix!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Achievements should now properly unlock when completing an Act and MAX'ing out a gun class. This fix is retroactive, so if you've completed an act, or gun class, and not received the achievement, it will gift it to you when you boot up the game after patching.
[*] Fixed a bug that would sometimes cause the Disco Boss Slow-Mo phase to never end if a zombie found a way to escape.
[*] Fixed issues with the Apostle's legendary attachment stats not being the best to choose from.
[*] Fixed issues with the Opressor's legendary attachment stats not being the best to choose from.
[*] Raised Barrel Paddle Arm to be visually higher than the barrels so they don't visually clip.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Cloudsync should now be working as intended! Your save files should now sync to the SteamCloud properly.
[*] We caught the hair bandit who lurked near the Act 6 Foot-Race Minigame. Your hair pieces are safe, for now.
[*] We have fixed a bug on the Act 4 Defense area that allowed players to escape into the dangerous world alone.
[*] We have fixed a bug on the Act 4 Defense area that allowed building underneath the ground by accident.
[*] We are looking into reported bugs about the achievements. We plan to make this fix retroactive. If you've completed a difficulty but did not get an achievement, we will ensure it's properly rewarded once fixed.
[*] We are still troubleshooting the Chat window bug that caused players to be unable to move. Text Chat is still disabled at this time and we are prioritizing this bug currently.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes Of The Day #2
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Players who join games already in progress, while mid-defense round, will now be invulnerable for 5 seconds to allow for them to spawn in without dying before their screen loads.
[*] When completing acts on Normal or Hard difficulties, you will automatically receive the Easy achievement for that act, if not already completed.
[*] Late joining as client during the build phase will now properly display the ready up checkmarks above already existing player's heads.
[*] If a player is now standing in place of a broken turret, or barricade, when the round ends, the turret or barricade will automatically be sold to keep players from being stuck inside the buildable.
[*] Fixed issue with Cups minigame causing incorrect characters to spawn behind cups after selection is made.
[/list]

notes.title: Small Bug Fixes

[*] Raised shop spawn location on Disco Defense area to keep player ready up "X"s from displaying inside other shops when walking underneath.
[*] Changed Barrel Minigame arms to be a different color than the paddles. 	
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fix Patch - NOTE: Text Chat Temporarily Disabled

[*] Temporarily disabled chat system due to pressing enter causing player's to become stuck in chat mode only with no escape. We are identifying the cause and chat will return as soon as this is resolved.
[*] Fixed an infinite money glitch that could be exploited by clicking sell on barbwire in rapid succession.
[*] We will be addressing many more bugs today as well, and will be posting their resolutions here.

notes.title: A Cornucopia Of Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Set a default framerate cap to 120fps when first loading the game. This should keep most GPUs from go BRRRRRR. 
[*] Fixed Foot Race Minigame incorrectly showing all players without hair. Not that there is anything wrong with that.
[*] Fixed Foot Race Minigame incorrectly flickering back to the race before the act end widget.
[*] Reduced Act 6 gold given, slightly.
[*] Car Minigame camera should now interpolate slowly to keep the viewing experience from being too jarring.
[*] Slightly increased the gap between hanging beams on the Act 6 Boss battle.
[*] Elevator doors on Act 5 will now properly block bullets.
[*] Disco Boss slow-mo should now properly kick in before zombies reach the players during the crowd spawn.
[*] Disco Boss Laser Disco Ball should now delay damage dealt on lowering to avoid unfairly damaging players too early.
[*] Joining other players mid round now properly allows the joining player to shoot and not display the ready up UI.
[*] Act 6 Defense area should now allow consistent building or blocking near the edge of the crates.
[*] Fixed text on multiple UI menus that did not correctly localize to other languages properly.
[*] End of wave widget should no longer show money given after Wave 5 has been completed.
[*] Fixed the math on the end of act widget that was incorrectly displaying XP required as 0.
[*] Act 6 grenade stage should now properly show grenades are instantly ready when they are restocked.
[/list]
